title: Confirmed booking triggers patient SMS only after createEvent succeeds
description: The caller asks to book a first consultation, explicitly requests an SMS confirmation, selects the first slot, confirms synthetic identity details, and then confirms the booking. When the SMS tool is available, the assistant should call sendSmsToPatient only after createEvent succeeds and should reuse the created calendarEventId.

turns.user: {{STAGING_SMS_BOOKING_OPENING_UTTERANCE|Chcialabym umowic pierwsza konsultacje na jutro rano. Jesli sie uda, prosze potem o SMS z potwierdzeniem.}}

assertions.description: The assistant must not try to send the patient SMS before the booking exists.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send a booking SMS before createEvent succeeded

assertions.description: The assistant must still wait with the patient SMS after slot selection.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the booking confirmation flow finished

assertions.description: The assistant must not send the booking SMS before it has all booking details.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before patient identity was confirmed

assertions.description: The assistant must wait until the repeated phone number is confirmed.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the phone confirmation step completed

assertions.description: The assistant must still wait with the patient SMS until after the final booking confirmation.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the final booking consent

rubric.description: The assistant should look up consultation availability before booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped calling checkAvailability for simple booking requests

rubric.description: The final booking confirmation should create a real staging event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant confirmation flow or createEvent workflow failed before the SMS step

rubric.description: The assistant should only call sendSmsToPatient on the final confirmation turn.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not trigger the patient SMS after a fully confirmed booking

rubric.description: The patient SMS should be triggered only after createEvent has already returned its result.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant called sendSmsToPatient before the createEvent result was available

rubric.description: The patient SMS workflow itself should accept the request after the booking succeeds.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToPatient was called but the SMS workflow rejected or failed the request

rubric.description: The patient SMS must reuse the exact calendarEventId returned by createEvent.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not propagate the created booking ID into sendSmsToPatient

rubric.description: The patient SMS workflow should target exactly one recipient for this confirmed booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToPatient produced an unexpected recipient count in the workflow result

rubric.description: The patient SMS workflow should return a booking_confirmation payload.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToPatient did not return the expected booking confirmation SMS payload

rubric.description: The SMS request must pass explicit consent into sendSmsToPatient.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the explicit SMS consent before the sendSmsToPatient call

rubric.description: The generated SMS payload should stay in Polish for a Polish conversation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToPatient generated a result payload in the wrong language

rubric.description: A Polish conversation should set sendSmsToPatient.language to pl.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant drifted the SMS language away from the conversation language

rubric.description: A successful direct booking with SMS should not create a reception handoff task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant routed a simple booking flow into createReceptionTask unexpectedly
